# card-location

The card's launch directory, its branch kept fresh by the repo poll, where Claude works when elsewhere, and the bind's model name.

- Spec: `docs/features/card-location/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/card-location/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/reporefresh*.go
go: internal/session/location*.go
go: internal/session/repo*.go
e2e: web/e2e/card-location.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/card-location.ts
```

## Protocol

- `ws.session` — The Session object

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/lifecycle-bind-model-display-name-is-id` — A SessionStart naming a different model sets the display name to the id until the status line confirms it; the same id changes nothing. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: lifecycle, card-location) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-bind-model-display-name-is-id.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-branch-refreshed-by-repo-poll` — An alive session's branch and worktree flag are re-read from its launch directory on a 5 s repo poll plus a nudge, not from hooks or a file watcher. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: lifecycle, card-location) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-branch-refreshed-by-repo-poll.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-card-shows-launch-directory-marks-claude-elsewhere` — The card, shell, docs reader and file drop stay on the launch directory; a secondary ↳ readout shows where Claude is only while in another checkout. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: lifecycle, rail, focus, tiles, card-location) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-card-shows-launch-directory-marks-claude-elsewhere.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-claude-location-from-main-agent-cwd` — Claude's location is read from every main-agent hook's cwd and the status line's working directory; never CwdChanged's target and never subagent-marked events. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: lifecycle, ingest, card-location) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-claude-location-from-main-agent-cwd.md`

## Lessons

- `kb:lesson/off-lock-reading-revalidated-at-apply` — Two repo-poll races had one cause: a git reading taken outside the manager lock was applied later without re-checking what it was taken against. (active, 2026-10-01; features: card-location, lifecycle) → `docs/lessons/off-lock-reading-revalidated-at-apply.md`
